patch_list: No-ops LicenseClient.checkLicense(Context) and LicenseClient.initializeLicenseCheck() to prevent the PairIP license verification from running. Required for the app to start when installed via Morphe/SAI (not from Play Store).
Free ads rewards (skip ad, grant unlock)

Patches ShowRewardedWeaponAd (and similar ad-reward methods) to skip the ad display and immediately grant the reward (weapon/skin/map unlock). Searches for the pattern 'ldr w9, [x8, #0xec]; cmp w9, #7; b.eq; cmp w9, #9; b.ne' and NOPs both…
Skips Google Play Billing and credits IAP items (Remove Ads) directly. OPTIONAL: The other patches already give you unlimited coins and no ads.
Unlimited coins (real - patches coin deduction + branch)

Real unlimited coins patch. Searches libil2cpp.so for the coin-deduction pattern (sub w8, w8, w21; ...; str w8, [xN, #0x18]; b.le/b.lt) and NOPs BOTH the str instruction AND the conditional branch that follows it. Previous version only NOP…
Unlock all (weapons, skins, colors, modes, no ads + level bypass)

Hex patches libil2cpp.so to: (1) NOP level checks in AchatWeapon (pattern-based: searches for cmp w9, #51 + b.lt and cmp w9, #499 + b.lt). (2) NOP coin checks in AchatWeapon, AchatSkin, AchatColor (3x) (offset-based, verified on 67MB lib).…
